::: {#def-frequentist-paradigm}
#### Frequentist paradigm

In the **frequentist** paradigm of statistical inference,
an unknown parameter $\param$ is a fixed constant,
probability describes long-run frequencies over repetitions
of the data-generating process,
and uncertainty about $\param$ is quantified by the [sampling distribution](estimation.qmd#def-sampling-distribution)
of an estimator $\hparam$.

Source: @wikipedia_frequentist_inference.
:::
